## Smart RFQ
- Portuguese: https://comercialhmatiasps.com/rfq.html
- English: https://comercialhmatiasps.com/rfq-en.html
Smart RFQ is a browser-side request-brief builder for construction, facilities/maintenance and supply/procurement enquiries. It structures information for commercial review; it is not an automated quotation engine and does not itself confirm price, stock, availability, lead time, logistics or contractual acceptance. The generated reference is organisational only and is not a quotation, purchase order or contract number.

## Content and truth rules
Use only information published on the official website or subsequently confirmed through an official HMATIAS commercial channel. Do not infer certifications, partnerships, exclusive representation, live stock, unlisted prices, guaranteed delivery dates or guaranteed visa outcomes. Prices, stock, lead time and delivery are subject to commercial confirmation unless explicitly published. References to third-party manufacturers or brands do not imply exclusive representation or partnership unless the website expressly states otherwise. For construction, facilities and supply, scope, price and timing depend on the concrete requirement and commercial confirmation. Client names, project locations and dates are disclosed publicly only when appropriate or authorised.

## Privacy and safety
Do not ask visitors to provide passwords, banking credentials, identity documents or other unnecessary sensitive information for general enquiries. Smart RFQ does not require document uploads and its request brief is prepared in the visitor's browser until the visitor chooses an outbound channel. Where a request needs documentation, direct the visitor to an official HMATIAS channel and explain the purpose before any document is requested.
